displayName: Configure the default paste format of URLs copied from Microsoft Edge, and determine if additional formats will be available to users (User)
categoryName: Microsoft Edge - Default Settings (users can override)

options.displayName: The plain URL without any extra information, such as the page's title. This is the recommended option when this policy is configured. For more information, see the description.
Titled Hyperlink: A hyperlink that points to the copied URL, but whose visible text is the title of the destination page. This is the Friendly URL format.
Coming soon. If set, behaves the same as 'Plain URL'.
